name: chuchotage-windows-electron
description: Electron shell for the Chuchotage Windows companion prototype.

scripts.build:backend: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$dotnet = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dotnet/dotnet.exe'; & $dotnet publish ../Chuchotage.Windows/Chuchotage.Windows.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true"
scripts.package: npm run build:backend && npm run stage:backend && node node_modules/electron/install.js && electron-packager . Chuchotage --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --executable-name=ChuchotageHost --ignore=dist && node scripts/stage-launcher.js
